title: Long- and short-term effects of extraction of compromised first permanent molars in children
summary: This study aims to assess the effects of extraction in childhood on tooth alignment in more detail and to investigate chewing efficiency and oral health-related quality of life
conditions: Extraction of the six-year molars in children

interventions.name: Patients (6 -15 years old) who have had at least one first permanent molar extracted in the last 1 to 4 years.
Patients (6 -13 years old) who will have one or more first permanent molars extracted

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Consent to participate
Exclusion criteria:
No enough information about the extraction
